name: 水印检测
description: Analyzes AI watermark and signature patterns
mechanism:
This method detects digital watermarks for video forensic authentication:

1. **VisibleWatermark检测**: The method searches for visible watermarks — logos, text overlays, station identification marks. Their presence, position, and integrity provide provenance information. Cropping or overlaying to remove watermarks indicates potential manipulation intent.

2. **InvisibleWatermark提取**: Robust invisible watermarks embedded in the frequency domain (DCT, DWT coefficients) or spatial domain are extracted. Common watermarking standards (Digimarc, BWARN) are tested. Intact watermarks verify content authenticity; corrupted watermarks indicate post-watermark manipulation.

3. **C2PA/ContentCredentials检测**: Modern content authenticity standards (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) embed cryptographically signed provenance metadata. The method checks for C2PA manifests and verifies digital signatures, providing chain-of-custody information for the content.

4. **Watermark一致性分析**: If watermarks are present, they should be consistent across all frames. The method checks temporal watermark stability — partial watermark removal (only in the deepfaked face region) or watermark corruption in specific frames indicates selective manipulation.

5. **AI-GeneratedContentWatermark**: Some AI generators embed their own watermarks (SynthID by Google, DALL-E metadata). The method searches for known AI generator watermarks. Detection of an AI generator watermark provides direct evidence of synthetic content generation.
parameters:
分析类型: metadata
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through watermark detection analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
